SLJIT native code generator

Upstream: https://github.com/zherczeg/sljit
Commit: 23d64b71b8f5fa51d774a01459770f7e1b68d371

The unmodified sljit_src component and upstream license are vendored here.
BMSX builds sljitLir.c directly; upstream tests, examples and build scripts are not included.
This dependency generates host machine code. It defines no BMSX instruction or data format.
